downloadedSourceCountNote: Zero is correct and is the assignment's pinned value. Nothing was downloaded and the Delaware perimeter was not contacted. Every finding is drawn from the retained repository binary, the retained capture of the Judiciary's own forms index, and the adopted edition row.

method.description: Metadata correction from retained evidence alone. The retained Form 281E binary was opened and its printed caption, court, county selector and field mechanism read directly; the Delaware Courts forms index was read from a retained capture; and both were compared against the adopted edition row. No network retrieval was attempted and the assignment requires none.
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition requires establishing from retained official evidence and the official index alone that Form 281E is a charge and additional-charges continuation sheet rather than a primary petition, recording that its document_role PETITION classification is wrong, that its workflow key must identify a continuation or extension-sheet role, and that the 2018 continuation sheet may not satisfy a primary-filing component. All four are established below from retained evidence only.

finding.headline: Form 281E is a charge extension sheet, and the adopted edition classifies it as a PETITION. The role is wrong. The title, however, is the issuer's own — the Delaware Family Court literally captions the sheet 'PETITION FOR EXPUNGEMENT OF ADULT RECORD CHARGE SHEET', which opens with the exact title of Form 281 and is the origin of the confusion rather than a transcription error in the edition.
finding.correctionIsRoleNotTitle: The edition's official_title should be qualified rather than replaced, because replacing it with the index title would discard the caption the artifact actually bears. The defect that must be corrected is document_role and the workflow key that encodes it.

twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.formFaceCaption: PETITION FOR EXPUNGEMENT OF ADULT RECORD CHARGE SHEET
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.formFaceCaptionSource: read verbatim from the retained binary, third paragraph of the document body, directly beneath the court and county block
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.officialIndexTitleSource: the Delaware Courts forms index, Title column, read from the retained capture
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.whyBothMatter: The index calls it an extension sheet and states its role plainly. The form itself is captioned as though it were a petition. A worker reading only the artifact would conclude it is a petition; a worker reading only the index would conclude it is a continuation. The index is right about the role and the caption is right about what is printed.
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.editionRecordedTitle: Petition for Expungement of Adult Record Charge Sheet
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.editionRecordedTitleAssessment: Accurate to the form face and therefore not a fabricated or spliced string. Recording it as spliced would be wrong. What it lacks is any signal that the document is a continuation, which the index supplies and which the row's own notes already state.
twoOfficialNamesForOneDocument.correctionToAnEarlierRecord: The completed rcap-de-official-download-automation-blocked record characterised this title as 'spliced from Form 281'. Direct measurement of the retained binary shows the caption is the issuer's own. The role finding in that record stands; the title characterisation is corrected here.

roleDefect.internalContradiction: The same row calls the document a PETITION in its workflow key and its document_role, and an official DOCX continuation sheet in its notes. Both cannot be right. The notes are right and the role is wrong.
evidenceForTheCorrectRole: The Judiciary's own index Title column reads 'Adult Expungement Charge Extension Sheet'.
The edition row's own notes already say 'Official DOCX continuation sheet.'
The form face captions itself a CHARGE SHEET, and a charge sheet enumerates charges belonging to a petition rather than commencing a proceeding.
Its body is a repeating charge grid — Crim. Case No., File No. and repeated fill fields — with no prayer for relief, no verification and no signature block of the kind a petition carries.

The Delaware Family Court publishes a matching juvenile pair in which 282D and 282M are the petitions and 282E is the charge sheet. The E suffix marks the charge sheet in both families, which is a naming convention rather than a coincidence.
roleDefect.correctedWorkflowKey: the key must identify a continuation or extension-sheet role rather than PETITION; DE:FORM-281E:PETITION:EN cannot stand
roleDefect.canonicalPathConsequence: The canonical relative path encodes the role and inherits the defect, so it needs regenerating with the corrected role.

primaryFilingSatisfactionFinding.question: May the 2018 continuation sheet satisfy a primary-filing component?
grounds: Role. A charge extension sheet is not a filing that commences a proceeding. It attaches to a petition and has no independent existence in the case.
Identity. The Delaware Family Court adult expungement petition is Form 281, 'Petition For Expungement of Adult Record', a distinct document with its own number and its own index row.
Currency. Form 281E carries an index revision date of 09/21/2018. Form 281 carries 11/26/2025. Seven years and two months separate them, and the newer document is the one a component would need.
Completeness. A packet emitting 281E alone would deliver a participant a list of charges with nothing to attach it to.
primaryFilingSatisfactionFinding.howTheSubstitutionWouldHappen: Form 281 is not retained by the adopted edition and Form 281E is. A worker resolving the Family Court primary filing would search the edition, find one Delaware row whose document_role is PETITION and whose official_title begins 'Petition for Expungement of Adult Record', and bind it. Nothing in the row's structured fields would contradict them — only the free-text notes would, and notes are not what a resolver reads.
primaryFilingSatisfactionFinding.form281Status: unmanifested; its acquisition is blocked at the Delaware perimeter and is assigned to the attended-retrieval job in this same shard

measuredStructure.pageCount: not applicable — a .docx has no fixed pagination until rendered; the edition correctly records pages as null
measuredStructure.geometry: not applicable for the same reason
measuredStructure.fieldMechanism: legacy Word form fields — FORMTEXT and FORMCHECKBOX field codes, not an AcroForm and not content controls
measuredStructure.fieldMechanismConsequence: Neither the acroform_fill lane nor a coordinate-overlay lane accepts this as-is. A renderer would have to drive Word form fields or convert first. Recorded as an observation about the artifact; no lane is assigned.
measuredStructure.issuer: The Family Court of the State of Delaware
measuredStructure.issuerBasis: the first line of the document body reads 'The Family Court of the State of Delaware'
measuredStructure.scopeBasis: The second line is a three-way county selector — New Castle County, Kent County, Sussex County — which is every county in Delaware. Scope follows from the selector covering the whole State, not from any service address.
measuredStructure.bodyShape: a repeating charge grid keyed on Crim. Case No. and File No. with repeated fill fields, consistent with an extension sheet and inconsistent with a petition

editionCorrection.requiresRoleCorrectionDetail: document_role PETITION must become a continuation or extension-sheet role.
editionCorrection.requiresWorkflowKeyCorrectionDetail: DE:FORM-281E:PETITION:EN encodes the wrong role and must be regenerated with the corrected one.
editionCorrection.requiresTitleQualificationDetail: Keep the form-face caption as the official title because it is what the artifact bears, and record the index title 'Adult Expungement Charge Extension Sheet' alongside it as the issuer's own role-bearing name. Replacing one with the other loses evidence either way.
editionCorrection.requiresRevisionCorrectionNote: REV-2018-09 agrees with the index revision date of 09/21/2018.
editionCorrection.requiresAssetClassCorrectionNote: packet_form remains defensible for a sheet that is filed with a petition. The class is not the defect; the role is.
editionCorrection.requiresPrimaryFilingGuardDetail: The row should carry an explicit statement that it may not satisfy a primary_filing component, so a resolver cannot reach it for the Family Court petition slot while Form 281 is unmanifested.
editionCorrection.correctableNowDetail: Every correction here rests on retained evidence. None waits on the Delaware perimeter, and none waits on the attended retrieval of Form 281.

sourceContractAndMaterialization.sourceContractEligibleWhy: The asset is digest-stable and retained, but a source contract pins an identity to a role, and the role recorded is wrong. Pinning it now would pin the defect.
sourceContractAndMaterialization.materializationEligibleWhy: Materializing under DE:FORM-281E:PETITION:EN would carry a PETITION role for a continuation sheet into the runtime contract, and the canonical path encoding that role would be pinned with it.
sourceContractAndMaterialization.receiptWouldNotBePermitted: A receipt is evidence custody, not generation permission, and in any case identity and role are not exact here — role is precisely what is wrong.
sourceContractAndMaterialization.afterCorrection: Once the role and key are corrected the asset is a normal retained continuation sheet and a receipt becomes mechanical, subject to the unresolved Delaware licensing position.

licensing.why: The Delaware Judiciary's terms pages sit behind the same F5 BIG-IP perimeter that blocks its forms. Nothing was read and nothing may be inferred in either direction.
licensing.doNotInfer: Possession of the retained docx is not permission. A retained binary is evidence custody, not a licence.
licensing.notAnsweredHere: No licence question is assigned to this job.

doNotSubstitute.why: The document 281E must not be substituted FOR. Form 281 is the Family Court adult expungement petition, revised 11/26/2025, and is unmanifested. This is the substitution this job exists to prevent.
The juvenile charge sheet, revised 11/26/2025. Same E-suffix convention, same Family Court, different population. Its 2025 date makes it look like a newer 281E.

The Superior Court additional-charges extension sheet, revised 06/12/2024. It is the Superior Court analogue of 281E and performs the same function in the other Delaware court. The two are not interchangeable because the courts are not.

No family is unlocked: Form 281 remains unmanifested behind an attended retrieval, and the three Superior Court identities remain unretained.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Delaware official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. Four of the five assigned Delaware identities have no bytes at all, licensing is unresolved, generation is not permitted and runtime is disabled.
implementationFamilyEffect.netEffect: A correction that removes a wrong answer rather than supplying a missing one. Its value is that it forecloses a substitution which would otherwise look correct to every structured check.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: the document, issuer, court, scope, revision, structure and function are established from the artifact and the issuer's index. It is not acquisition_required: the binary is retained and digest-matched. It is not a title correction, which is what the row superficially looks like it needs — the title is the issuer's own caption and the defect is the role beneath it.

expectedDownstreamEffect: The Delaware edition stops recording a 2018 charge extension sheet as a PETITION, and the Family Court primary-filing component is explicitly guarded against resolving to it while Form 281 stays unmanifested. The reason the defect is convincing is documented: the Family Court's own caption for the sheet opens with the exact title of the petition, so the edition's title is accurate to the artifact and only the role betrays the error — which is why a structured check would not have caught it. An earlier characterisation of that title as spliced is corrected. No binary is acquired, no receipt is created, nothing enters version control, no component is rebound, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
